usage: Photographs and map screenshots are visual references only, not runtime textures. Sculptures are simplified original Canvas drawings. Dimensions, planting and furniture placement are estimates, not a measured survey or a claim about the current condition.

references.title: Памятник Ленина во Владикавказе
references.author: Игорь Улитин
references.observed: Standing coat silhouette, hand at chest and lowered cap; dark cylindrical pedestal with round mouldings, square stepped platform.

references.title: Vladikavkaz Pamiatnik David-Soslan
references.author: Os-Bagatar
references.observed: Soslan's raised knee and arm, decorated cup, flared stone stem, sculptural spouts, round reddish stone basin and working water jets; slatted benches behind.

references.title: Памятник нарту Сослану на проспекте Мира
references.author: Rost.galis
references.dateNote: Uploaded for Wiki Loves Monuments 2018; the displayed 1899 camera date is unusable and is not treated as the capture date.
references.observed: Basin-to-person proportions, bronze patina, stone rim, wooden benches with metal arms, trimmed hedges and paving bands.

references.title: Пользовательские ракурсы 2ГИС: 02, 09, 10 и общий план
references.usage: Private visual references, not redistributed in the game.
